smallStepsBody: A little curiosity goes a long way.
helpBody: Choose Library to find a book and check whether a copy is available. Ask an EVG volunteer when you are ready to borrow it.
demo: Design preview · Fictional examples · Changes reset on refresh
footer: Made for curious minds. Growing together with EVG.
homeTitle: A new day, a new discovery.
homeBody: Pick up a book. Follow your curiosity. Learn at your own pace.
atYourPace: There is a whole world in the little things. Keep exploring, one page at a time.
physicalReading: Read your physical book, then record your progress here.
goalBody: Try this example goal with an EVG volunteer.
goalTask: Share one thing I learned from a book
goalEncourage: No rush. A little progress is enough.
educatorPicks: Example shelf · In future, chosen by EVG educators
noRush: Every book is a new beginning.
sampleBook: Fictional book for this preview. No digital book file is included. Reading time is an example.
askStaff: Ask an EVG volunteer to borrow a physical copy.
libraryBody: Browse a book, see what is available, and find something you enjoy.
trySearch: Try another word or show all books.
loanNote: Sample loan. A volunteer records borrowing and returns. Your reading list is separate.
exploreBody: Start with one question. You do not need to know the answer yet.
editorial: Sample activities for everyone. These are not personalised recommendations.
interestsBody: Choose any topics you like. You can change your mind whenever you want.
recommendationsBody: For now, browse freely. Later, EVG can use your interests to suggest reviewed topics. AI will only be considered after simple recommendations prove insufficient.
communityBody: Discover what sharing our learning could look like. These are fictional examples.
fictionalWork: Example work · Not a real student submission
sharingBody: Sharing projects, comments, and rewards will come later, with an EVG review process and a named moderator. Nothing can be published from this preview.
staffBody: Try one sample circulation task. This open preview has no account protection and contains no real student records.
staffLoanNote: This updates the sample availability in Library. It does not mark the book as read. Due dates, permission checks, lost copies, and real records are future work.
operationsLater: More tools, one step at a time
operationsBody: Catalogue editing, learner accounts, moderation queues, exports, and recovery tools remain planned. First, validate these screens with EVG staff.
signInPreview: Explore the EVG design preview. Accounts will be added later; please do not enter personal information.

nature.title: How does a seed grow?
nature.body: Notice the small changes in the plants around you.
nature.instruction: Look at a plant with a volunteer. Draw its leaves and describe one thing you notice. Do not taste unknown plants.

stories.title: Every place has a story.
stories.body: Imagine a new adventure in a familiar place.
stories.instruction: Choose an imaginary character. Tell a volunteer where they go, who they meet, and one kind thing they do.

science.title: What makes a bridge strong?
science.body: Explore shapes using a little paper and curiosity.
science.instruction: With a volunteer, fold a sheet of paper and rest it across two books. Compare a flat sheet with a folded sheet. Use only light paper objects.

garden.title: Our little leaf journal
garden.body: An example of noticing different leaf shapes and drawing what changes each day.

bridge.title: One sheet, many possibilities
bridge.body: An example paper bridge project: try a shape, notice what happens, and try again.

auth.title: A place to grow.
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to keep your reading journey together.
auth.name: Display name
auth.passwordHelp: Use 12–128 characters. A long phrase is easier to remember.
auth.invalidName: Enter a display name of 1–80 characters.
auth.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
auth.passwordMismatch: The passwords do not match. Please check both fields.
auth.linkExpired: That email link has expired or was already used. Request a new link and try again.
auth.invalidCredentials: Check your email and password, then try again.
auth.unconfirmed: Confirm your email first. You can use Email link to request another sign-in link.
auth.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.emailDelivery: Email delivery is not enabled for this address yet. Please contact the EVG team.
auth.failed: We could not complete that request. Check your connection and try again, or ask EVG staff for help.
auth.recoverHelp: Enter your email and we will send a secure password reset link. If the address is not registered, no account information is revealed.
auth.recoverCheckEmail: If an account uses {{email}}, a password reset link will arrive soon. Check your spam folder if needed.
auth.passwordUpdated: Your password was updated. Please sign in with the new password.
auth.passwordUpdatedSignOutFailed: Your password was updated. Close this shared browser tab, then sign in again with the new password.
auth.invalidRecovery: This password reset link is missing, expired, or already used. Request a new link to continue.
auth.checkEmail: A secure email link will arrive at {{email}}. Open it to finish, and check your spam folder if needed.
auth.linkHelp: The link works once and opens this account page. You can return here to request another email after the wait.
auth.magicLinkHelp: Already registered? Receive a one-time sign-in link by email instead of entering a password.
auth.sharedDevice: Using a shared device? Sign out when you finish.
auth.notConfigured: Account setup is not connected yet. You can still browse the design preview.
auth.pilotBanner: Accounts and library: live test · Learning, activities and sharing: sample previews

catalogue.body: Browse the books registered by EVG staff.
catalogue.manageBody: Add books, update their details and keep physical copy counts accurate.
catalogue.copySafety: Existing copies stay in the inventory so loan history is not lost. Use the circulation desk to record damaged or lost copies.
catalogue.emptyTitle: The library is ready for its first books
catalogue.empty: Books added by authorised staff will appear here for learners to browse.
catalogue.emptySearch: Try a different title or topic, or clear the filters to see every registered book.
catalogue.loadError: We could not load the catalogue. Please try again.
catalogue.circulationLater: Copy counts show inventory, not current loan availability. Borrowing, returns and personal reading records will be connected in a later step.
catalogue.addTitle: Add a book to the library.
catalogue.staffBody: Register the title and its physical copies together.
catalogue.signInRequired: Sign in with an authorised staff account to add books.
catalogue.staffRequired: Your account does not have library staff permission. Ask the EVG administrator to grant access.
catalogue.author: Author (optional)
catalogue.saveError: The book could not be saved. Check the titles, copy count, connection and staff access. If editing still does not work, ask the site owner to finish enabling catalogue management.

staffAccess.title: Staff permissions
staffAccess.signedInNoRole: {{email}} is signed in without staff access.
staffAccess.canClaim: This confirmed email is on the first-admin bootstrap list. Claim administrator access to start managing staff.
staffAccess.cannotClaim: No administrator exists yet. A trusted database operator must add the first approved email to the bootstrap list before it can claim access.
staffAccess.adminOnly: Only administrators can grant or revoke staff access.
